description: Runs the whole naming job on the server and returns one recommended domain with its real price and a confirm_url, plus runners-up. From a concept it generates candidates, grades the unregistered ones on measurable properties with a trademark signal, re-checks the best against the registry live, and prices them in order until one quotes. For when the user wants a name picked rather than a list, for example 'what should we call this?'. The answer shows the count at every step, why the pick won, its trademark signal with the caveat, and any name refused along the way with the reason. The confirm_url is not a purchase: a person opens it and pays on scopeweb.io. Cannot spend money.

budget_cents.description: Optional ceiling that reorders candidates; it never changes a price.

concept.description: What is being named, as a word or short phrase, e.g. 'calm inbox'.

project_id.description: Optional project for budget context on the quote.

tlds.description: Endings to search. Defaults to com/io/ai/app/dev/co.

name: recommend_name

recommendation.description: The pick with price and confirm_url, or null with a reason.

steps.description: How many names each step saw.
